name: Push-Up

instructions.setup: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width on the floor, feet together, creating a straight line from head to heels.
execution: Lower your body by bending elbows until chest nearly touches the floor.
Keep elbows at a 45-degree angle to your torso.
Push back up to the starting position by extending arms fully.
tips: Engage glutes and core to prevent lower back sagging.
Maintain a neutral neck position looking slightly ahead of your hands.

description: The fundamental horizontal pushing exercise for developing upper body strength and stability.

name: Pull-Up

instructions.setup: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
execution: Hang with arms fully extended in a dead hang.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Continue until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself with control.
tips: Avoid using momentum or 'kipping'.
Keep your core tight to prevent swinging.

description: The gold standard for upper body pulling strength and back width.

name: Bodyweight Squat

instructions.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out.
execution: Lower your hips back and down as if sitting in a chair.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Descend until thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.
tips: Keep your weight distributed through the whole foot.
Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.

description: The basic lower body movement for building leg foundation.

name: Parallel Bar Dip

instructions.setup: Support your body on parallel bars with arms locked out.
execution: Lower your body by bending elbows until shoulders are below elbow height.
Lean slightly forward to engage the chest more.
Push back up to the starting position.
tips: Keep elbows tucked close to the body or at a 45-degree angle.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders at the top.

description: A powerful vertical pushing exercise for the triceps and chest.

name: Inverted Row

instructions.setup: Lie under a low bar, grasp it with an overhand grip, and keep your body in a straight line.
execution: Pull your chest to the bar by retracting your shoulder blades.
Keep the core tight and body rigid.
Lower yourself back to the starting position with control.
tips: The lower the bar, the harder the exercise.
Focus on squeezing the shoulder blades together at the top.

description: A horizontal pulling exercise essential for posture and back thickness.

name: Diamond Push-Up

instructions.setup: Place hands together under your chest so thumbs and index fingers form a diamond shape.
execution: Lower your chest until it touches the back of your hands.
Keep elbows close to your ribs.
Push back up to full extension.
tips: If it hurts your wrists, slightly separate your hands.
Maintain a solid plank position.

description: A push-up variation that emphasizes the triceps.

name: Hanging Leg Raise

instructions.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width grip.
execution: Keeping legs straight, raise them until they are parallel to the floor or higher.
Slowly lower them back down without swinging.
tips: To reduce difficulty, perform with bent knees (Knee Raises).
Exhale as you lift the legs.

description: One of the most effective exercises for developing core strength and hip flexor control.

name: Pike Push-Up

instructions.setup: Start in a push-up position, then walk feet forward until your body forms an inverted V-shape.
execution: Lower your head forward toward the floor to form a tripod shape with your hands.
Push back up to the pike position.
tips: Look at your feet to maintain a neutral neck.
Keep your hips high throughout the movement.

description: The primary bodyweight progression toward the handstand push-up.

name: Pistol Squat

instructions.setup: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended straight out in front.
execution: Lower your hips down as far as possible on the standing leg.
Keep the extended leg off the ground.
Drive back up to a standing position.
tips: Use a pole or TRX for assistance if you lack balance.
Work on ankle mobility if your heel lifts off the floor.

description: An advanced single-leg exercise that requires strength, balance, and mobility.

name: Forward Lunge

instructions.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
execution: Step forward with one leg and lower your hips until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keep the front knee over the ankle.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.
tips: Keep your torso upright.
Switch legs each rep for a balanced workout.

description: A fundamental movement for unilateral leg strength and stability.

name: Chin-Up

instructions.setup: Grasp the bar with an underhand grip (palms facing you), shoulder-width apart.
execution: Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Lower yourself back to a full hang.
tips: Focus on pulling with the biceps as well as the back.
Maintain a full range of motion.

description: A pull-up variation that puts more emphasis on the biceps.

name: Wide Grip Pull-Up

instructions.setup: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip significantly wider than shoulder-width.
execution: Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower back down with control.
tips: Do not go too wide, as it can cause shoulder impingement.
Focus on driving the elbows down into your sides.

description: Increases the demand on the lats by reducing the mechanical advantage of the arms.

name: Muscle-Up

instructions.setup: Grasp the bar with a false grip (if possible) or a standard overhand grip.
execution: Perform an explosive pull-up, pulling the bar to your lower chest/waist.
Lean your torso forward over the bar to transition from pull to push.
Press your body up until arms are fully extended (dip).
tips: Requires a high level of pulling and dipping power.
The transition is the most difficult part of the movement.

description: The ultimate calisthenics skill combining a pull-up and a dip.

name: Archer Push-Up

instructions.setup: Place hands very wide, with one arm acting as the primary mover and the other kept straight.
execution: Lower your body toward the primary hand while the auxiliary arm slides out straight.
Push back up to the center.
Switch sides or alternate.
tips: Keep the straight arm as straight as possible.
This is a great progression for the one-arm push-up.

description: A unilateral push-up variation that builds immense chest and tricep strength.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up

instructions.setup: In a push-up position, turn your hands slightly outward and lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
execution: Maintain the forward lean while lowering your chest.
Push back up while keeping the lean consistent.
tips: The further you lean forward, the harder the exercise.
Keep your protraction (rounded upper back) at the top.

description: Mimics the planche position to build specific shoulder strength.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat

instructions.setup: Place one foot behind you on a bench and the other foot forward.
execution: Lower your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the ground.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back to the start using the front leg.
tips: Ensure your front foot is far enough forward to keep the knee from overextending.
Focus on balance and control.

description: An excellent unilateral leg exercise for correcting imbalances.

name: Glute Bridge

instructions.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
execution: Lift your hips toward the ceiling while squeezing your glutes.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
tips: Drive through your heels.
Don't overarch your lower back.

description: A fundamental glute activation and strengthening exercise.

name: Hollow Body Hold

instructions.setup: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
execution: Lift your legs and upper back off the floor, keeping your lower back pressed firmly into the ground.
Hold this 'banana' shape.
tips: If your lower back arches, lift your legs higher or bend your knees.
Focus on creating maximal tension in the core.

description: The foundational core position for all calisthenics skills.

name: L-Sit

instructions.setup: Support your weight on your hands with arms locked out.
execution: Lift your legs until they are parallel to the floor, forming an L-shape.
Keep your shoulders depressed and chest up.
tips: If straight legs are too hard, start with a tucked L-sit.
Focus on pushing the floor away.

description: A static hold that builds incredible core and tricep compression strength.

name: Wall Walk

instructions.setup: Start in a push-up position with your feet against a wall.
execution: Walk your feet up the wall while walking your hands toward the wall.
End in a stomach-to-wall handstand.
Reverse the movement back to the start.
tips: Keep your core tight to avoid 'banana back'.
Control the movement throughout.

description: A great exercise for shoulder stability and handstand preparation.

name: Calf Raise

instructions.setup: Stand on the edge of a step or on flat ground.
execution: Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Hold for a second, then lower back down below the level of the step.
tips: Pause at the top and bottom to maximize the stretch and contraction.
Perform one leg at a time to increase difficulty.

description: The standard exercise for building the lower leg muscles.

name: Superman Hold

instructions.setup: Lie face down with arms extended in front and legs straight.
execution: Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Hold the position while squeezing your glutes and lower back.
tips: Look at the floor to maintain a neutral neck.
Focus on length rather than height.

description: An essential exercise for strengthening the posterior chain and lower back.

name: Cossack Squat

instructions.setup: Stand with a very wide stance.
execution: Shift your weight to one side and squat down while keeping the other leg straight.
The straight leg's toes should point up as you descend.
Push back to the center.
tips: Keep your heel on the floor on the working leg.
Maintain an upright torso.

description: Combines unilateral strength with deep flexibility for the inner thighs.

name: Plank

instructions.setup: Place forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, feet together.
execution: Hold a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes.
tips: Avoid letting your hips sag or hike up.
Think about pulling your elbows toward your toes to engage the core more.

description: The fundamental isometric core stabilization exercise.

name: Side Plank

instructions.setup: Lie on your side with your weight on one forearm and the side of your foot.
execution: Lift your hips to form a straight line.
Hold the position and then switch sides.
tips: Keep your shoulder directly over your elbow.
Don't let your hips drop toward the floor.

description: Target the lateral core and obliques.

name: Mountain Climber

instructions.setup: Start in a high plank position.
execution: Rapidly alternate bringing your knees toward your chest.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your hips low.
tips: Do not bounce your hips.
Focus on speed and core control.

description: A high-intensity exercise for core and cardiovascular health.

name: Burpee

instructions.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
execution: Drop into a squat, place hands on floor, jump feet back to a push-up position.
Perform a push-up (optional), jump feet forward, and jump explosively into the air.
tips: Maintain a rhythm to manage fatigue.
Focus on explosive movement.

description: The ultimate full-body conditioning exercise.

name: V-Up

instructions.setup: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
execution: Simultaneously lift your torso and legs to touch your toes, forming a V-shape.
Lower back down with control.
tips: Try to keep your legs straight.
Exhale as you reach for your toes.

description: An advanced core exercise that targets both upper and lower abs.

name: Jumping Jack

instructions.setup: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
execution: Jump while spreading your legs and swinging your arms above your head.
Jump back to the starting position.
tips: Maintain a steady pace.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.

description: A classic warm-up and cardiovascular exercise.

name: Bicycle Crunch

instructions.setup: Lie on your back with hands behind your head and knees bent.
execution: Bring your opposite elbow to your opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Alternate sides in a cycling motion.
tips: Focus on rotation rather than just pulling your head.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.

description: One of the best core exercises for targeting the obliques.

name: Bench Dip

instructions.setup: Sit on a bench, place hands next to hips, and move your feet forward.
execution: Lower your hips by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the start.
tips: Keep your back close to the bench.
Extend your legs to make it harder.

description: A beginner-friendly dip variation focused on the triceps.

name: Close Grip Pull-Up

instructions.setup: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands closer than shoulder-width.
execution: Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower back down with control.
tips: This version increases the range of motion for the lats.
Maintain a tight core.

description: A pull-up variation that challenges the arms and lower lats.

name: Handstand Hold (Against Wall)

instructions.setup: Kick up or walk up into a handstand with your back or stomach toward a wall.
execution: Hold the position while maintaining a straight line.
Push the floor away and keep your core tight.
tips: Focus on shoulder protraction and elevation.
Look at your hands to maintain balance.

description: A fundamental skill for developing overhead pushing strength and balance.

name: Planche Lean

instructions.setup: In a push-up position, protract your shoulder blades (round your upper back).
execution: Lean forward as far as possible while keeping your arms straight.
Hold the position with max tension.
tips: Keep your elbows locked (straight).
The lean determines the intensity.

description: The foundational isometric hold for the planche progression.

name: Scapular Pull-Up

instructions.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
execution: Using only your shoulder blades, pull them down and back.
Lift your body slightly without bending your elbows.
Lower back to a dead hang.
tips: This is a subtle movement.
Focus on isolating the movement of the shoulder blades.

description: Develops the necessary shoulder blade control for proper pull-up technique.

name: Scapular Push-Up

instructions.setup: Start in a high plank position with arms straight.
execution: Squeeze your shoulder blades together to lower your chest slightly.
Push your shoulder blades apart to return to the start.
Keep your arms straight throughout.
tips: Do not bend your elbows.
Focus on the movement of the shoulder blades.

description: Builds serratus anterior strength and scapular health.

name: Archer Pull-Up

instructions.setup: Grasp the bar with a very wide overhand grip.
execution: Pull yourself toward one hand while keeping the other arm straight.
Return to the start and repeat on the other side.
tips: The straight arm should slide along the bar.
A key progression for the one-arm pull-up.

description: A unilateral pulling exercise that emphasizes one side of the back at a time.

name: Wall Sit

instructions.setup: Lean against a wall and slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
execution: Hold the position for a set amount of time.
Keep your back flat against the wall.
tips: Ensure your knees are directly over your ankles.
Do not rest your hands on your legs.

description: An isometric leg exercise to build quad endurance.

name: Box Jump

instructions.setup: Stand in front of a sturdy box.
execution: Squat slightly and swing your arms to jump onto the box.
Land softly in a squat position.
Step back down.
tips: Focus on landing with your whole foot on the box.
Step down rather than jumping down to protect your joints.

description: A plyometric exercise for developing explosive power in the legs.

name: Hindu Push-Up

instructions.setup: Start in a pike position (hips high).
execution: Lower your head and sweep your chest close to the floor.
Push your chest up toward the ceiling while lowering your hips (upward dog pose).
Push your hips back to the starting pike position.
tips: The movement should be fluid and circular.
Great for shoulder and spine mobility.

description: A dynamic push-up variation that incorporates mobility and strength.

name: Russian Twist

instructions.setup: Sit with your knees bent and feet slightly off the ground, leaning back.
execution: Twist your torso to the right and touch the floor with your hands.
Twist to the left and repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged to protect your lower back.
Follow your hands with your eyes to ensure rotation.

description: A rotational core exercise focusing on the obliques.

name: Flutter Kicks

instructions.setup: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your glutes for support.
execution: Lift your legs slightly and alternate kicking them up and down in a small range.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Keep your legs straight.

description: A low-impact core exercise for abdominal endurance.

name: Handstand Push-Up (Wall)

instructions.setup: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
execution: Lower your head toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
tips: Maintain a tight core to avoid arching.
The head should go slightly forward of the hands (tripod).

description: The ultimate bodyweight shoulder-pressing exercise.

name: Jump Squat

instructions.setup: Start in a standing position.
execution: Lower into a squat and then jump as high as you can.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
tips: Absorb the landing through your whole foot and bend your knees.
Keep the movements explosive.

description: A plyometric variation of the squat for power and heart rate.

name: Negative Pull-Up

instructions.setup: Jump or use a stool to get your chin above the bar.
execution: Lower yourself as slowly as possible until your arms are fully extended.
tips: Aim for a 5-10 second descent.
Maintain control through the entire range of motion.

description: The best way to build the strength needed for a first pull-up.

name: One-Arm Push-Up

instructions.setup: Place one hand on the floor and spread your feet wide for balance.
execution: Lower your body while keeping your torso as level as possible.
Push back to the start.
tips: Squeeze the glutes and core to manage rotation.
Wider feet make it easier.

description: A high-level unilateral push-up requiring immense core stability.

name: Hanging Knee Raise

instructions.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar.
execution: Pull your knees toward your chest.
Lower them back down with control.
tips: Avoid swinging the body.
Focus on curling your pelvis toward your chest.

description: The foundational hanging core exercise.

name: Toes to Bar

instructions.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar.
execution: Keeping legs as straight as possible, swing your feet up to touch the bar.
Lower back down under control.
tips: Engage your lats to help pull your body back as you lift your legs.
Don't use excessive momentum.

description: An advanced dynamic core and pulling exercise.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap

instructions.setup: Start in a high plank position.
execution: Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips from rocking.
Repeat with the other hand.
tips: The wider your feet, the easier it is to stay stable.
Minimize hip movement.

description: Develops core stability by removing one point of contact.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge

instructions.setup: Lie on your back, one foot flat and the other leg extended in the air.
execution: Drive through the heel of the floor foot to lift your hips.
Hold at the top, then lower slowly.
tips: Keep your hips level throughout.
Squeeze the glute hard at the top.

description: Increases intensity on the glutes and hamstrings unilaterally.
